product.title: Desert View Grand Canyon Jeep Tour

description.text: A three-hour open-air Jeep tour follows Desert View Drive east from Grand Canyon Village to the Desert View Watchtower. Stops include Duck on a Rock Viewpoint, Grandview Point, and Pipe Creek Vista, plus admission to the Grand Canyon IMAX film at the visitor center.

highlights: Open-air Jeep tour along Desert View Drive
Stops at Grandview Point and Desert View Watchtower
Included Grand Canyon IMAX movie admission
Departures from Tusayan visitor center area

start.description: Meet at the Jeep tour staging area near the National Geographic Visitor Center, Tusayan, AZ 86023.

end.description: Return to the Tusayan staging area; IMAX tickets valid for same-day screening.

product.itinerarySummary: A three-hour open-air Jeep tour follows Desert View Drive east from Grand Canyon Village to the Desert View Watchtower.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon South Rim
itineraryItems.description: Begin the east-rim Jeep route from the village area toward Desert View Drive.

itineraryItems.title: Duck on a Rock Viewpoint
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop at Duck on a Rock Viewpoint along Desert View Drive.

itineraryItems.title: Grandview Point
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Grandview Point for views above Horseshoe Mesa and the inner canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon Desert View Watchtower
itineraryItems.description: Visit the historic Desert View Watchtower at the eastern South Rim.

itineraryItems.title: Pipe Creek Vista
itineraryItems.description: Brief overlook stop at Pipe Creek Vista before returning west.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon Visitor Center Imax
itineraryItems.description: Receive IMAX admission for the Grand Canyon: River at Risk film screening.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Desert View Grand Canyon Jeep Tour?
Where does the tour depart from at the Grand Canyon?
faqs.answer: Meet at the Jeep tour staging area near the National Geographic Visitor Center, Tusayan, AZ 86023.
